title: A Unified Physics-Informed Neural Network for Modeling Coupled Electro- and Elastodynamic Wave Propagation Using Three-Stage Loss Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2602.13811v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks present a novel approach in SciML that integrates physical laws in the form of partial differential equations directly into the NN through soft constraints in the loss function. This work studies the application of PINNs to solve a one dimensional coupled electro-elastodynamic system modeling linear piezoelectricity in stress-charge form, governed by elastodynamic and electrodynamic equations. Our simulation employs a feedforward architecture, mapping space-time coordinates to mechanical displacement and electric potential. Our PINN model achieved global relative L2 errors of 2.34 and 4.87 percent for displacement and electric potential respectively. The results validate PINNs as effective mesh free solvers for coupled time-dependent PDE systems, though challenges remain regarding error accumulation and stiffness in coupled eigenvalue systems.

translated_title: 一种统一物理信息神经网络，采用三阶段损失优化建模耦合电弹波传播
translated_abstract: 物理信息神经网络提供了一种科学机器学习中的新颖方法，通过损失函数中的软约束将偏微分方程形式的物理定律直接集成到神经网络中。本研究探讨了应用PINN求解一维耦合电弹动力学系统，该系统以应力-电荷形式建模线性压电性，由弹性和电动力学方程控制。我们的模拟采用前馈架构，将时空坐标映射到机械位移和电势。我们的PINN模型在位移和电势上分别实现了2.34%和4.87%的全局相对L2误差。结果验证了PINN作为耦合时变偏微分方程组有效无网格求解器的能力，尽管在耦合特征值系统中仍存在误差累积和刚性问题。
tldr: 本研究提出了一种统一物理信息神经网络，通过三阶段损失优化成功求解一维耦合电弹波传播问题，实现了位移和电势的低误差预测，验证了PINN作为无网格求解器的有效性。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a unified physics-informed neural network with three-stage loss optimization to solve one-dimensional coupled electro-elastodynamic wave propagation, achieving low errors in displacement and electric potential, validating PINNs as effective mesh-free solvers.
